t: What Robot Maintenance Prediction Database Is All About
title: What Robot Maintenance Prediction Database Is All About
description: Maintenance prediction forecasts robot failures: motor current trends (rising = wearing), vibration (bearing faults), temperature (friction/cooling), and encoder errors. Models range from thresholds to ML; accuracy measured (precision/recall on predicted failures). The payoff: fix during planned stops, not during production. Predict, schedule, prevent. This database is the complete maintenance prediction: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
